sqlMap.update: UPDATE icomtrxl SET key_9 = 'D', key_10= to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE doc_name = #DOC_NAME# AND target = #TARGET# AND key_1 = #KEY_1# AND key_2 = #KEY_2# AND nvl(key_9,' ') != 'D'
sqlMap.select: SELECT nvl(decode(b.status,'R','C',b.status),' ') AS STATUS, nvl(a.legacy_po_no,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, nvl(to_char(a.legacy_po_seq,'FM00000'),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, nvl(trim(c.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL),'000') AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, nvl(trim(a.ref_if_no||a.buyer_item_no),' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, nvl(b.invoice_date,' ') AS INVOICE_DATE, nvl(b.inv_qty,0) AS INV_QTY, nvl(a.po_no,' ') AS PO_NO, nvl(b.inv_no,' ') AS INV_NO, nvl(to_number(b.inv_seq), 0) AS INV_SEQ, nvl(a.process_type,' ') AS PROCESS_TYPE, nvl(c.car_no,' ') AS CAR_NO, nvl(c.car_person_name,' ') AS CAR_PERSON_NAME FROM icompodt a, icomivdt b, icomivhd c WHERE b.buyer = #TARGET# AND b.inv_no = #KEY_1# AND b.buyer = a.buyer AND b.po_no = a.po_no AND b.po_seq= a.po_seq AND a.status != 'D' AND a.process_type = '0' AND b.buyer = c.buyer AND b.inv_no = c.inv_no union all SELECT nvl(decode(b.status,'R','C',b.status),' ') AS STATUS, nvl(a.legacy_po_no,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, nvl(to_char(a.legacy_po_seq,'FM00000'),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, nvl(trim(b.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL),'000') AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, nvl(trim(a.ref_if_no||a.buyer_item_no),' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, nvl(b.inv_date,' ') AS INVOICE_DATE, nvl(b.inv_qty,0) AS INV_QTY, nvl(a.po_no,' ') AS PO_NO, nvl(b.inv_no,' ') AS INV_NO, nvl(to_number(b.inv_seq), 0) AS INV_SEQ, nvl(a.process_type,' ') AS PROCESS_TYPE, nvl(b.car_no,' ') AS CAR_NO, nvl(b.car_person_name,' ') AS CAR_PERSON_NAME FROM icompodt a, wmsivdt b WHERE b.buyer = #TARGET# AND b.inv_no = #KEY_1# AND b.buyer = a.buyer AND b.po_no = a.po_no AND b.po_seq= a.po_seq AND a.status != 'D' AND a.process_type != '0'
